decisions.reason: A piqué upholstery fabric builds directly on the firm's core upholstery and design know-how and has a page of its own, so management can read its early results with confidence and refine it.

A semi-transparent bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the firm's established decorative sheer expertise, though it is only mentioned on the website, so the signals are weaker; it stays for another season to gather learning.

A flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric draws on the firm's functional contract-textile knowledge, serves hospitality project demand and is featured on its own page, which makes it a strategic keeper.

The double-face wool-blend fabric relies on production partners and matches the move to renewable fibres, but its blend may conflict with the goal of reducing hard-to-recycle materials and its visibility is low, so the firm keeps it but watches it closely.
The wool bouclé leno sheer combines the firm's sheer weaving know-how with renewable wool in line with its sustainability direction, which justifies keeping it despite limited early visibility.
